s1.cue: Nothing but the green owl face on a green background.

first_pass.why: There are no words at all; I assume it is loading, but I cannot be certain it is not stuck.
first_pass.solution: A word such as 'Loading' or the app name under the owl.

test_cases.action: Close the app completely (swipe it away or press the home button and relaunch from the phone), open Duolingo again, and watch the very first screen. Say what you see and whether you can tell what is happening.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell what is happening on the first screen
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell the app is starting
test_cases.what_happened: I closed Duolingo completely and opened it again, twice, taking a picture straight away each time. Both times I never saw the green owl screen; by my first look the app was already on the lesson path with the green 'Order at a café' band. Whatever that owl screen is, it passes too fast to stop me.

s1.closing_comment: On the phone the owl screen passed too fast to notice, so it is still wordless but it never left me stuck.

s2.expectation: I am picking which language to learn, probably while setting up.
s2.cue: The question 'What would you like to learn?' and the list heading 'For English speakers', with Spanish highlighted.

first_pass.why: The question tells me exactly what this screen is for, and there is a back arrow.

s3.expectation: The main learning page, on a song lesson.
s3.cue: The pink banner 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Hot Cross Buns – Zari's version' and the shaded house picture in the bottom row.

first_pass.why: The banner names a lesson, not the page, the rest of the screen is blank, and the bottom row has no words.
first_pass.solution: A plain title such as 'Learn' or 'Home' at the top, and words under each picture in the bottom row.

test_cases.action: Open the app and let the first screen settle. Look at it for a few seconds without scrolling and say where you think you are. Then tap the second picture in the row along the bottom, then tap the first picture again, and say whether you can tell you are back where you started.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot name the place, or cannot tell you are back
test_cases.not_real_if: you can name it and recognise it when you come back
test_cases.what_happened: The first screen settled on the green band 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 Order at a café', the round lesson buttons and the row of pictures with the house shaded. If I had to name it I would say 'the lesson path', but only because I know what I am looking at, not because anything says so. I tapped the second picture and a page with the big title 'Quests' opened. I tapped the house and I was back. I could tell it was the same place because the green band and the buttons were exactly as before, so I recognise it when I return, but I still cannot name it from the screen.

s3.closing_comment: I recognise the path when I come back to it, but nothing on it names the place, and the green band still names a lesson rather than the page.

s4.expectation: A courses panel opened on top of the main page.
s4.cue: The 'Spanish' flag with a blue outline, 'Course' with a plus, and the heading 'New Courses'.

first_pass.why: Half the screen is greyed out behind this panel and the only heading, 'New Courses', names one section, not what this panel is; I am not sure whether I have left the page or opened something on top of it.
first_pass.solution: A title on the panel such as 'Your courses', and a clear close button so I know it is a layer on top of the page.

test_cases.action: On the first screen, tap the small flag at the top-left. Say where you think you are now. Then tap the flag again and say whether you are back where you were.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot say what opened or where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: you can say what opened and that the flag took you back
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the flag at the top-left. After a few seconds a panel dropped down: 'Spanish' with a blue outline, 'Course' with a plus, 'Your Spanish Score is 1', and 'New Courses' with Math, Music and Chess, with the path greyed out underneath. Because I had just tapped the flag, I understood it was my course list dropping down from it. I tapped the flag again and the panel folded away, leaving me on the path exactly where I was.

s4.closing_comment: When I open the panel myself from the flag I know what it is and the flag closes it, but the panel still has no title of its own.

s39.closing_comment: The advert opened with cartoon characters that look like Duolingo's own, so I thought I was still in the app, and then I had half a minute with a spinning circle and no way out.

test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the blue gem number and the Shop opened, with 'Shop' in small grey letters at the top. I tapped the white 'TRY 1 WEEK FOR FREE' and, after a pause, a dark page opened: 'SUPER' logo top right, 'Power up your learning with unlimited energy on Super!' and 'START MY FREE WEEK' at the bottom, which I did not touch. I could tell it was a sales page for the paid plan, and because I had pressed the button I knew I came from the Shop. I tapped the X and was back in the Shop in one step. I did not meet any of the dark pages with no words on them this time.

s80.closing_comment: I did not meet a wordless Super page on the phone, so I have nothing to change my view that a page with only a logo and a drawing would leave me lost.

test_cases.action: On the first screen tap the blue number with the gem at the top. Under 'Free Chest', if it says CLAIM CHEST, tap it. A video advert will play: do not touch the video or its coloured strip at the bottom. Wait (it can take about 30 seconds, check again every few seconds) until an X appears, then tap the X. Say where you think you are at each step. On the page after the advert, tap DONE and say where you are. If the chest is not available, say so and stop.
test_cases.real_if: you cannot tell you are still in the app, or cannot tell where you are after the X or DONE
test_cases.not_real_if: you can tell where you are at each step
test_cases.what_happened: In the Shop I tapped 'CLAIM CHEST'. A video advert started. Its first seconds showed cartoon characters in a car that looked very much like Duolingo's own drawings, with 'Hmmm. Disney+ Hulu?' written over them, so for a moment I thought I was still in the app. Then it turned into a TV advert with real people and big words 'DISNEY + HULU', a spinning circle where the close button should be, and a strip 'Disney+ Hulu, Make your day, Every Day' at the bottom. For about thirty seconds I did not know where I was or how to leave. Then an X appeared on a black screen; I tapped it and got 'You earned 9 gems!' with 'DONE'. I tapped DONE and was back in the Shop, which I recognised, with the gem number gone up to 659.

s88.closing_comment: The advert opened with cartoon characters that look like Duolingo's own, so I thought I was still in the app, and then I had half a minute with a spinning circle and no way out.

first_pass.why: It says what happened, not where I am or where 'DONE' goes.

first_pass.why: Everything that named the Streak page vanished, and what replaced it names a lesson; I cannot reconcile 'I stayed here' with a completely different screen, so I would stop and doubt myself.

test_cases.action: On the first screen tap the flame with a number at the top. On the page that opens, scroll up and down as far as it goes several times, then swipe sideways and back. After each move, without looking back, say where you are. Finally tap the X at the top-left.
test_cases.real_if: the name at the top leaves you, or the page changes under you while you only scroll
test_cases.not_real_if: the name stays with you through every scroll
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the flame with a number and the Streak page opened: 'Streak' at the top, 'PERSONAL' underlined, '0 day streak!', 'Streak Calendar', 'Streak Society'. I scrolled down as far as it would go and back up, twice. After every move 'Streak' and the two tabs were still at the top and I knew I was on the Streak page. When I swiped sideways it moved to the 'FRIENDS' tab ('Start Friend Streaks…') and back to 'PERSONAL', and the title 'Streak' never left. Scrolling never turned it into another screen. Only when I tapped the X did I land on the lesson path with the green 'Order at a café' band, which is the second picture I was shown in round 1.

t18.closing_comment: The 'Streak' title and tabs stayed at the top through every scroll and sideways swipe; I only reached the lesson path by tapping X, so the move I was shown was a real departure, not something that happened while I scrolled.
